## Frequently Asked Questions

### How is the Universal Assistant priced?

Per employee, per year, flat. The rate steps down as your headcount grows and reflects your workforce mix. Usage is unlimited and never metered. If your employees love it and use it ten times more than expected, that's our cost, not yours.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### How is the AI Colleagues Platform priced?

An annual platform fee plus usage, billed in tokens. Usage applies only to the autonomous AI Colleagues you run on the platform, never to the Universal Assistant. If you only buy the Universal Assistant, you will never see a token bill.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### What's the difference between the Assistant and AI Colleagues?

One question decides it: who triggers the work? If a person asks, like "request my time off" or "reset my password," that's the Universal Assistant, covered by the flat subscription. If it runs on its own, screening every resume, processing every invoice, monitoring a queue 24/7, that's an AI Colleague on the platform. Same skills underneath; the trigger decides the license.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### What are tokens, and why do you bill in them?

Tokens are the unit AI models themselves charge in, the same one Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google publish prices for. Most platforms convert them into proprietary credits you can't audit. We don't. One thing to be clear about: tokens apply only to the AI Colleagues Platform. The Universal Assistant is never metered, so there is no usage charge on top of your subscription. On the platform, every AI Colleague run reports its own token usage, per step, in your dashboard, so you can check our math anytime.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### Will usage costs surprise me?

No – because you see the numbers before you commit. During your proof of value, we run your key use cases in a test environment and show you the measured cost per run. Multiply by your volumes and that's your budget.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### Why don't you publish prices?

Because no two enterprises buy the same thing. Your price reflects your headcount, your workforce mix, and the use cases you deploy. What we publish is the full structure: what you pay for and what moves the number. Answer the six questions above and you'll have a number built for your organization within one business day.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)

### How fast can we go live?

It depends on your use cases, their complexity, and your overall stack. On average, our customers go live in 45 days.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/icons/caretUp.svg)
